title: What software architecture is: components, interaction and environment

videos.script: Ask ten engineers what software architecture is and you get ten answers. {{title}} Some say the diagram on the wall. Some say the choice of framework. Some say whatever the most senior person decided. This lesson starts from four definitions that people have argued over for more than thirty years, and finds what they share. {{definitions}} Three things keep coming back. The pieces of a system. The way those pieces talk to each other. And the world the system lives in. {{three}} We look closely at the middle one, because it is the one people forget. The same three services, joined in three different ways, fail in three different ways. {{connectors}} Then the world outside. Customers, regulators, the company's own teams, the people on call at night. {{environment}} The whole course follows one company. Carreto is an invented freight marketplace in Curitiba, with fifty engineers. Renata Okubo has worked there for six years, and this week she becomes its first software architect. {{carreto}} Nothing needs installing. You need a text editor, a way to draw boxes, and the habit of asking why a decision was made.
